subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should outbound Telegram album support be accepted as a bundled Telegram plugin feature now, and if so should it extend existing mediaUrls delivery or introduce a distinct message action?
rationale: The issue requests a new user-visible message-tool capability, and the open fork PR chooses a new action/API shape that may not be the cleanest owner-boundary fit.

options.title: Port Through Existing MediaUrls
options.body: Implement sendMediaGroup inside the existing Telegram media delivery funnels so current multi-media payloads become albums when eligible and fall back to sequential sends otherwise.

options.title: Adopt New Explicit Action
options.body: Accept a separate Telegram-specific media-group action if maintainers want album sending to be opt-in instead of automatic for eligible multi-media payloads.

options.title: Defer Product Direction
options.body: Keep sequential fan-out and leave album semantics unimplemented until maintainers decide the message-tool API shape.

recommendation.title: Port Through Existing MediaUrls
recommendation.body: Implement sendMediaGroup inside the existing Telegram media delivery funnels so current multi-media payloads become albums when eligible and fall back to sequential sends otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: Blame and existing cleanup comments make this the best available routing candidate for the Telegram send-funnel decision.
